ticket-01-implementation.assignment.json.instructions: Implement only the approved ticket in this worktree. Do not commit. When repair_context is present, repair the current changes using its rejected revisions, failure diagnostic, and the check_results reports and output artifacts. Return submitted or human-decision-needed; only the harness can declare Done. For unavailable requirements or changes to approved contracts, stop immediately, preserve current work, and return human-decision-needed. Describe the precise decision and relevant approved contract in summary/unresolved_questions, and available evidence in acceptance_evidence. Do not invent requirements or change approved inputs/interfaces.

Return findings classified as blocking or optional. For unavailable requirements or changes to approved contracts, return a blocking finding with human_decision_needed true. Identify the approved contract in requirement, supporting evidence/consequence, and the precise decision in resolution. Do not resolve the conflict by changing approved inputs or interfaces.

report_contract.instructions: Emit one JSON object to stdout; diagnostics go to stderr. Copy assignment identity fields exactly, including their JSON types. Extra diagnostic metadata is allowed but has no authority.

ticket-02-spec.assignment.json.instructions: Review the exact revision against the approved ticket/spec and actual check results. Do not edit source. Return findings classified as blocking or optional. For unavailable requirements or changes to approved contracts, return a blocking finding with human_decision_needed true. Identify the approved contract in requirement, supporting evidence/consequence, and the precise decision in resolution. Do not resolve the conflict by changing approved inputs or interfaces.
